def factor_volume_regime_amplified_momentum(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    momentum = df_copy["close"] / df_copy["close"].shift(20) - 1
    _, _, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=20)
    vol_ratio = vol_ratio.clip(0.5, 2.0)
    df_copy["factor_volume_regime_amplified_momentum"] = momentum * vol_ratio
    return df_copy["factor_volume_regime_amplified_momentum"]
description: Price momentum is confirmed by volume: high momentum with high volume indicates stronger conviction, while low volume momentum may be noise. This factor replaces the manual 20-day volume ratio with the reusable classify_volume_regime tool's vol_ratio (volume relative to 20-day EMA), which provides a smoother and more stable volume confirmation. Clipping the vol_ratio bounds extreme values. The core mechanism remains volume-amplified momentum, preserving the parent's elite predictive profile while improving robustness and code simplicity.
